title: Stalks of extension by zero of an abelian sheaf on an open subspace
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, let $j:U\to X$ be the inclusion of an open subset, and let $G$ be an abelian sheaf on $U$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Define the abelian presheaf $j_{p!}G$ on $X$ by $(j_{p!}G)(V)=G(V)$ when the open $V\subseteq U$ and $(j_{p!}G)(V)=0$ otherwise, with the induced restriction maps. Let $j_!G$ be its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], with stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. For $x\in U$, the canonical map $G_x\to(j_!G)_x$ is a natural isomorphism of abelian groups; for $x\in X\setminus U$, the stalk $(j_!G)_x$ is zero. These identifications are natural in $G$ and identify the stalk at $x\in U$ of the adjunction map $j_!j^*F\to F$ with the identity of $F_x$ for every abelian sheaf $F$ on $X$; here $j^*F=F|_U$ is the abelian sheaf $W\mapsto F(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) with the restriction maps of $F$, and the adjunction map is induced by the presheaf map $j_{p!}j^*F\to F$ that is the identity on $F(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ and zero otherwise.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 00A5 (lemma-j-shriek-abelian), parts (2), (3), (5), with Definition 00A4 (definition-j-shriek-structures); the final naturality clause is the adjunction map used in Modules, Lemma 02UT

proof.text: By the stalk-sheafification lemma, the canonical map from the stalk of the presheaf j_{p!}G to the stalk of its sheafification j_!G is an isomorphism, compatibly with the germ maps.

If x is outside U, every open neighborhood V of x is not contained in U, so (j_{p!}G)(V)=0. The filtered colimit defining the stalk of j_{p!}G is therefore the zero abelian group, and the isomorphism in step 1 gives (j_!G)_x=0.

If x is in U, the neighborhoods V∩U, for V an open neighborhood of x in X, are cofinal among the open neighborhoods of x in U. On these neighborhoods j_{p!}G(V∩U)=G(V∩U), with the same restriction maps. The two filtered colimits are consequently canonically identified, giving G_x ≅ (j_{p!}G)_x; composing with step 1 gives the asserted natural isomorphism G_x ≅ (j_!G)_x.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 00A5 (lemma-j-shriek-abelian), part (2), and the definition of stalks

proof.text: All maps used above are induced by restriction maps and by the canonical sheafification morphism, so the identifications commute with morphisms of G. For F on X, the presheaf map j_{p!}j^*F→F is the identity on opens contained in U and zero otherwise; at x∈U its germ map is therefore the identity on F_x under the identification of step 3, while at x outside U the source stalk is zero. This is the stated naturality and adjunction-map clause.
